grammar.numbers: the number written large in navy marker, then circled in gold (stat) or boxed in blue (spoken number), a doodle beside it (calendar, percent, coins, bank, trend arrow), a curved arrow to its label; a percentage gets a hatched sketch bar; a number said during the hook is a small circled note in the corner
grammar.comparisons: the board split by a hand-drawn vertical line into two columns, VS circled in red at the top, values written large, the highlighted value underlined twice, the takeaway under a gold highlighter swipe
grammar.steps: a hand-numbered list under an underlined title; each item written, its box ticked in green marker as it is said, the current item under a gold highlighter
grammar.eligibility: classic verdict cue ✓/✗ (MotionTrack navy panel on the board)
grammar.change: classic change card (MotionTrack navy panel on the board)
grammar.trend: classic trend graph (MotionTrack navy panel on the board)
grammar.lenders: the logo on a white card taped to the board, a neutral note written above with a hand-drawn arrow down to it
grammar.captionPosition: navy marker words mid-board under a doodle when the board is free, a lower band when something is drawn; English line at the foot of the board

skinAxes.cover: whiteboard, house doodle drawn, title written in navy marker and underlined twice, keywords under gold highlighter, logo card top-right
skinAxes.captions: bold navy words written on the board, unspoken words faint, keywords and numbers under a gold highlighter swipe
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics on a white whiteboard in an aluminium frame; no footage, no one on screen
skinAxes.transitions: everything is drawn in (writing wipes, stroke-by-stroke doodles, rough circles and boxes) and wiped off with an eraser pass; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: glossy white board with faint ghosts of erased marker, a slow sheen, aluminium frame, marker tray with three markers
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
